messages:
tanya-sales: Heads up — LatticeWorks POC is stalled. CTO says they need a written commitment on 99.9% regional uptime for Dedicated + a pricing cap if we hit >2B tokens/mo. Legal/security also flagged KMS BYO questions. Can we sync?

sam-se: On it. Quick Q — are they asking committed reserved capacity or just a soft SLA for Dedicated?

tanya-sales: They want reserved capacity (seed month) + a contract SLA. CTO will escalate if we don't present options by EOD tomorrow.

alejandra-cto: @tanya-sales I can take the SLA wording draft. Need concrete numbers for burst vs baseline throughput and what fallback model looks like (latency targets).

ravi-infra: For reserved pool sizing we need their 95th pct token/sec estimate. Do we have telemetry from the POC traffic?

cora-sales-lead: I sent the POC perf trace earlier today — avg qps ~ 350, peak ~ 1.2k for short windows. Will paste link. https://redwood.internal/poctraces/LATT-20250412

matt-sre: From infra POV: 99.9% in-region is doable on Dedicated but depends on multi-az placement + cross-az failover plan. If they want hard financial SLA, ops needs a runbook and a canary fallback (lower-cost model) option.

sam-se: For pricing cap: recommend two-tier: committed baseline price (reserved GPU pool) + overage price with a ceiling for the first 3 billing cycles. We can bake in a cost-smoothing clause. I can draft numbers.

pricing-bot: Suggested template: "Committed monthly capacity X GPUs / Y tokens -> $Z/month. Overage capped at 25% of committed cost for first 90 days." — see /pricing/templates/enterprise-cap-floor.md

alejandra-cto: Regarding KMS BYO: we support customer-managed keys in Private and Dedicated via our KMS plugin, but we need their key rotation policy and whether HSM attestation is required. Legal will want key access guarantees.

tanya-sales: Legal already asked for a short answer doc for the customer. Can someone from security provide a one-pager by EOD?

ravi-infra: I can produce a concise KMS answer: details on encryption in transit/at rest, BYO integration steps, and rotation. Will include limitations: no direct access to CMKs from our control plane; key usage audited.

matt-sre: Also calling out network peering reqs — if they peer, failover within region is faster; without peering latency spikes on failover are possible. Recommend peering + reserved throughput.

cora-sales-lead: Customer asked about canary model fallback — what are compatible fallback models for their Llama-3-like base? Need assurance outputs won't degrade badly.

sam-se: Fallback models: we can route to a quantized variant we host with similar top-k/top-p configs. We'll provide eval prompts to show parity on their workload. Need sample prompt set from LatticeWorks.

tanya-sales: Action items: @alejandra-cto draft SLA language (due 12h), @sam-se draft pricing cap (8h), @ravi-infra KMS one-pager (EOD), @matt-sre runbook + peering rec (EOD). I'll consolidate and send to GTM. If anyone needs me to escalate to execs, ping.

pricing-bot: Note: if cap triggers, finance approval required for >$500k/mo credit exposure. Please flag early.

ops-bot: Incident playbook snippet attached: /ops/playbooks/dedicated-failover.md (added by ops-bot at 1742568000)

alejandra-cto: Draft SLA posted: https://redwood.internal/drafts/lattice-sla-v1.md — includes availability calc, exclusions, and remedy band. Feedback welcome.

sam-se: Pricing draft posted in thread doc: https://redwood.internal/drafts/lattice-pricing-cap-v1.md — used two-tier cap and 90-day smoothing.

tanya-sales: Nice. I'll loop in Finance and Legal after we finalize wording. Thanks everyone — will update after the exec sync at 3pm. :thumbsup:

matt-sre: 3pm sync noted. I'll prepare the quick-runbook slides for the CTO meeting.

cora-sales-lead: I'll prep the customer-facing email once docs are finalized.

ravi-infra: Uploaded KMS one-pager: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-byowhitepaper.pdf — callout: requires customer key policy docs for BYO enrolment.

tanya-sales: Last note — if Finance flags the exposure, we may need an exec signoff on a credit line. @ceo please standby.

ops-bot: Reminder: planned maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC — may affect non-dedicated routes. If needed we'll request waiver.

sam-se: Ok closing loop here for now. Will post any changes.
